description: This file defines an event listener class 'ConsoleFavouriteListener' for the Goteo application. It listens for project activation events and sends notification emails to users who have marked the project as a favorite if the project is below its minimum funding goal.

classes.name: ConsoleFavouriteListener
classes.description: An event listener class that handles the logic for notifying users about projects they favorited when those projects are active and below their minimum funding goal.

methods.name: onProjectActive
methods.description: Handles the project active event. Checks if the project is below minimum required funding and, if so, sends reminder emails to users who favorited the project.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array of events this listener subscribes to, specifically the PROJECT_ACTIVE event.
